text:
The sister is a life in being, and all of her children will be born during her lifetime, so the class gift to her children who reach age 25 is valid under the Rule Against Perpetuities. The deceased son never reached 25, so he has no interest; the living son and daughter, plus any future children of the sister, are the current and potential class members. Therefore, title is in the friend, the son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime.

CONFIDENCE: 95
